headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Prohibits paying costs incurred for name modifications of subsection 1 institutions from state funds.

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and notes. Provides that East Campus of Linn Technical College in Osage County shall be named State Technical College of Missouri when section 178.631 conditions are met.

headings.title: Transfer of gifted Marolf mineral rights to regents

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Authorizes the CMSU board of regents at its discretion to sell and convey all or part of the subsection 3 mineral rights in Howell, Laclede, Taney, Texas, Webster, and Wright Counties.

headings.title: Deed-based identification of covered mineral rights
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Identifies the mineral rights by reference to deeds recorded in the six listed counties transferring ownership from Howard W. and Margaret A. Marolf in December 1963.

headings.title: Fair market value consideration determined by regents
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Requires consideration for any future conveyance to equal fair market value at the time of conveyance, as determined by the CMSU board of regents.

headings.title: Deposit of conveyance proceeds into scholarship fund
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Directs proceeds from any future conveyance to accrue to the Central Missouri State University scholarship fund in accordance with the donors' expressed purpose.

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Places police officers under a board-designated officer or employee and requires pre-appointment chapter 590 peace-officer training or equivalent experience and certification.

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Explicitly restricts section 174.709 exclusively to moving violations.

headings.title: Applicability of section 173.205 definitions
